---
title: "Budget and Revenue"
---

This page examines the relationship between film production budgets and worldwide revenues. @fig-budget-revenue plots each film's budget against its worldwide revenue.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-budget-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Film budgets and worldwide revenues"
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Production Budget (millions of US dollars)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
